integrity: Finite face enumeration, explicit acyclic discrete-Morse matching certificate and dependency-free checker are supplied. All calculations have been subject to self-review only; no independent audit or authorship claim.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the full cap complex of the Desarguesian affine plane of order four. The face vector and integral homology rank 225 are previously tabulated in Lew (2018); only the certified homotopy refinement is asserted as new. General field-order and equivariant statements are not proved.
title: The cap complex of the affine plane of order four is a wedge of \(225\) three-spheres
